title: Workspace and CI foundation
deliverables: Create npm workspaces for web, worker, engine and protocol; strict TypeScript, compatible pinned dependencies, one lockfile, Node version pin and lint configuration.
Create minimal real React screen, Worker health route and pure package smoke tests; no game or public deployment yet.

Add root lint/typecheck/test:unit/build/check:docs scripts, local dev instructions, secret-safe ignore/example files, and PR GitHub Actions with read-only permissions. Document later test scripts as unavailable until their tasks.
Reserve Firebase public frontend config and FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID Worker config only; do not add Firebase databases, Admin SDK credentials or paid Firebase services.
acceptance: Fresh clone + npm ci + lint + typecheck + test:unit + build + check:docs pass.
Local browser loads scaffold and health endpoint; no success-only script stubs or credentials.
checks: Run all newly introduced scripts and record Node/package versions; validate build-kit Python script.

title: State types and deterministic setup
deliverables: Implement versioned engine state/types, canonical board loader, card IDs and validated setup for 2–4 unique players/roles.
Implement specified deterministic RNG and shuffle with independently reviewed frozen vectors; inject seed, never ambient randomness.
Implement setup sequence, card distribution, deck partitioning and invariant helpers.
acceptance: E01/E02 pass for all player counts; graph/config invalidity rejected; setup never mutates caller input.
Cube/card counts and exact initial phase/action count correct; zero seed rejected or explicitly normalized identically in all paths.
checks: Unit tests with fixed vectors, setup seeds and invalid roster/config cases; typecheck.

title: Movement treatment and construction
deliverables: Implement MOVE, DIRECT_FLIGHT, CHARTER_FLIGHT, SHUTTLE, TREAT, BUILD_CENTER and PASS in pure engine.
Centralize actor/phase/action validation and deterministic public events; implement Medic/Builder exact effects.
Return unchanged state on invalid command; no mutation of passed input. Automatic end-turn resolver is connected in T05.
acceptance: E03–E08 and relevant E23 cases pass; all card/action/supply costs exact.
No fourth cube, seventh center, passive Medic effect or accidental self-flight allowed.
checks: Positive/negative unit tests for each command, immutable-input checks, typecheck.

title: Sharing cures and discard continuations
deliverables: Implement GIVE_CARD, DISCOVER_CURE, DISCARD; Scientist/Courier abilities; visible-hand policy.
Represent DISCARD_REQUIRED and resume continuation explicitly, including recipient discarding after another player’s fourth action.
Implement immediate fourth-cure victory and terminal command rejection.
acceptance: E09/E10/E12/E21/E23 pass; duplicate card IDs, wrong recipient, wrong discarder and wrong phase rejected without cost.
Discard leaves exactly seven and consumes no action; fourth cure ends before automatic turn resolution.
checks: Unit tests around 7/8-card boundaries and all cure/transfer restrictions; typecheck.

title: Draw infection epidemics and losses
deliverables: Implement automatic DRAW/INFECTION progression and turn rotation; pause/resume on each drawn-card hand limit.
Implement deterministic outbreak chains, supply checks, infection deck refill, epidemic bottom draws/intensify and two-epidemic turns.
Implement loss reasons and deterministic first-terminal precedence; automatic effects resolve within one engine transition.
acceptance: E11/E13–E22 pass, including cycle and epidemic visited-set scope.
No persisted mid-infection state; only explicit hand-limit continuation interrupts automatic resolution.
checks: Unit scenarios for each loss, loop propagation order, bottom/top deck semantics and pending draw counts.

title: Engine invariants and independent rules review
deliverables: Add legal-action enumeration and randomized legal-sequence harness with saved failing seed/trace.
Run independent review against rules, add missing regression cases, document provisional balance and unsupported features.
Produce engine gate report in docs/evidence/T06.md without claiming gameplay balance from random tests.
acceptance: All E01–E24 pass; at least 100 seeds per 2/3/4 mode, bounded 1000-action exploration with explicit timeout reporting.
Replay yields identical results; invalid actions preserve state and RNG; no unresolved blocking rules defects.
checks: Full engine unit suite, randomized harness, lint/typecheck; independent review evidence.

title: Room persistence and protocol schemas
deliverables: Implement shared strict runtime schemas, public projection and API error envelope.
Implement GameRoom SQLite schema/migration, logical create/read and current snapshot persistence; separate local test entry point.
Add real Cloudflare runtime integration suite and root test:integration script. Local-only until real auth is complete.
acceptance: State survives re-instantiation with identical decks/RNG; public projection excludes all secret fields.
Unknown schema/protocol versions fail clearly; SQL parameters and API body validation work; O01 routes testable locally.
Protocol user IDs accept opaque Firebase UIDs (not UUID-only); only room/command IDs require UUID format.
checks: Workerd/SQLite integration tests and projection leakage tests; unit/typecheck/build.

title: Atomic command execution and retry safety
deliverables: Implement command processing transaction: membership, receipt/hash, revision, engine transition, state/events/receipt writes.
Return stored acceptance for exact retries; stale/reused-ID errors; commit before acknowledgment and broadcast hooks.
Introduce local-only fault injection at transaction and post-commit boundaries, never a deployed API.
acceptance: P01–P06 pass for transaction/restart portions, including raced same-version actions and failure between writes.
Duplicate after restart changes state once; error candidate never leaks into authoritative cache.
checks: Runtime race/fault/restart integration tests; full engine and protocol suites; review atomic boundary.

title: Private lobby invites and membership
deliverables: Implement idempotent room creation, cryptographic invites/rotation, authenticated-identity admission abstraction, stable seats and unique roles.
Implement readiness, owner-only start, owner transfer on lobby leave, roster freeze and membership authorization.
Handle private invite receipts, leaving-player retry exception and logical missing rooms without leaking data.
acceptance: P07/P08/S02/S08 pass against local test identities; max-four and role races atomic.
Start requires 2–4 ready unique roles; started game rejects joining/leaving; disconnect is not leave.
checks: Room integration tests, schema tests, negative admission/access tests.

title: Hibernating realtime and reconnect
deliverables: Implement one-use persisted room socket tickets, origin checks, hibernation sockets and durable connection attachments.
Broadcast member-only snapshots after commits; enforce socket caps, auth expiry and cleanup scheduling.
Implement client transport module with stable command IDs, current snapshot reconciliation and bounded retry/reconnect.
acceptance: P05/P06/S03/S04 and transport portions U02 pass locally; no always-running JS timers on server.
Commands remain HTTPS-only; lost updates recovered by snapshot; expired idle sockets lose access.
Socket auth expiry derives from verified Firebase ID-token exp, and refreshed reconnect retains user UID.
checks: Cloudflare socket integration tests, client transport unit tests, hibernation staging checks explicitly pending T17.

title: Microsoft Google auth and authorization
deliverables: Implement Firebase Web SDK Google/Microsoft popup login/logout, auth initialization, safe room return path, token refresh and short-lived invite fragment handling on the Spark plan.

Implement a Workers-compatible RS256 Firebase ID-token verifier using Google Secure Token X.509 certificates, pinned project issuer/audience and required time claims; derive opaque non-UUID actor UID from sub. Cache/import keys and test rotation/fetch failure.

Exclude local test keys and Firebase Auth Emulator bypasses from preview/production. Add public-config templates, popup/collision recovery UI and real-provider-check evidence sheet. No Admin SDK service account or Firebase game database.
acceptance: S01/S02/S05/S06/S09/S10 pass; no email-based authorization or open redirect; refresh retries preserve command ID.

T11 completes on automated auth/code gates; track U03/U05 real-provider/browser verification explicitly under T17. Missing account credentials block T17 external checks and production release, not local T11 implementation.
checks: Firebase-shaped JWT negative/rotation/cache tests, non-UUID UID test, production/emulator bypass test, popup browser smoke; actual Google/Hotmail staging evidence at T17.

title: Local playable board interface
deliverables: Implement responsive SVG board, role/pawn/card panels, threats/centers/supplies, phase/action indicators and legal action controls.
Use engine through a local transport adapter for hot-seat development; same view components later use network adapter.
Implement discard interruption and terminal result; original visual assets and keyboard/non-color labels.
acceptance: A complete local game can reach terminal result through UI; E12/E13 hand-limit interactions visible and correct.
U04 checks pass; no hidden deck/seed exposed through production UI module imports.
checks: Component interaction tests, production build inspection and manual keyboard/tablet walkthrough.

title: Connected lobby and multiplayer UI
deliverables: Connect login/home/invite/lobby/role/readiness/start screens to authenticated API.
Swap local adapter for network transport in deployed app; render server snapshots and pending/rejected actions.
Add private recent-room links, safe error states, connection/session banners and bounded public history.
Integrate Firebase popup login; handle blocked/cancelled popup and account-collision recovery without custom code exchange or untested redirect fallback.
acceptance: 2/3/4 separate identities join and play synchronized turns; nonactive players cannot act.
Stale-version rejection refreshes state without silently reissuing move; refresh returns to existing seat.
checks: UI integration tests plus initial independent-browser smoke; lint/typecheck/build.

title: Durable resume retention and compatibility
deliverables: Finish unified alarm scheduler for auth expiry/ticket cleanup/room retention, with tombstones and final deletion.
Add schema-version fixtures and migration handling; freeze incompatible rules and document compatible rollback.
Ensure resumed discard phase, decks and active seat survive all supported restarts; recent-room expired UX.
acceptance: P06/S04/O03 retention portions pass with fake time and real storage; reads do not extend expiry.
Expired rooms cannot revive via join/create retry; unknown versions never silently reset state.
checks: Runtime alarm/migration/restart tests; client expired-room tests.

title: Multiplayer browser regression suite
deliverables: Add Playwright contexts for 2/3/4 identities and root test:e2e; CI browser setup and sanitized failure artifacts.
Test full games plus near-terminal wins/losses, hand limit, lobby race, offline refresh, duplicate update and expired session.
Keep fixtures/test identity endpoints only in local harness; map acceptance IDs to named tests.
Cover S09/S10/U05 Firebase claim/cache and popup/emulator cases with local test adapters; reserve actual OAuth/browser evidence for T17.
acceptance: U01/U02/U04 repeatably pass; at least one full setup-to-terminal run per player count.
No shared-context fake multiplayer, skipped required assertions or test-only deployed routes.
checks: Full e2e suite repeated to diagnose flakes, integration/unit suites, production artifact check.

title: Abuse controls observability and load
deliverables: Implement bounded request/socket/history sizes, durable room rate limiting and supported edge create/join abuse controls.
Add sanitized structured logs/metrics and bounded 10-room load harness; document actual rate-limit semantics.
Audit security boundaries and asset bundles with independent review; resolve blockers.
acceptance: S05–S07 pass; no secret payloads in logs/traces; limits return useful 429 with Retry-After.
O02 harness runs locally and is ready for owned preview; performance claims remain pending measured staging results.
Measure Worker Free token-verification CPU with certificate/key caching; do not assert $0 compatibility solely from low traffic.
checks: Limit/security integration tests, bundle scan, local bounded load, independent review report.

title: Cloudflare preview deployment pipeline
deliverables: Validate/promote Wrangler template, environment bindings/migrations and build-time auth vars against pinned current tools.
Add trusted-main manual preview/production deployment workflow with scoped secrets and environment concurrency; no PR auto-deploy.
With owner-provided credentials, deploy preview and run OAuth, hibernation, namespace isolation, routing and load checks; document observed URLs and versions.

Use Firebase Spark projects with matching Worker/frontend project IDs, public Web SDK config and authorized domains. Verify Google/Hotmail popup on Cloudflare preview in Chromium and Safari/WebKit; do not enable Blaze or use service-account secrets.
acceptance: O01/O02/O03/O05 and U03 pass in actual preview; no claimed pass when account setup missing.
Published preview uses real auth, independent resources, no test bypass, and durable state. Production remains untriggered.
U05/S09/S10 Firebase checks and project isolation pass; no application /auth/callback or obsolete identity variables remain. Record actual free-tier CPU/request usage.
checks: Full CI, Wrangler validation, actual preview smoke/load, personal Microsoft + Google login and idle observation.

title: Release readiness and owner handoff
deliverables: Complete acceptance traceability report, independent final review and four-session manual playtest.
Rehearse compatible update/recovery in preview; verify operational limits, usage alerts and documented backup limitations.
Prepare owner release instructions, known issues and tested commit; trigger production only if owner explicitly authorizes that deployment.
acceptance: All required E/P/S/U/O criteria have passing evidence; no critical/high defects unresolved; O04 recovery rehearsal recorded.
Fresh-contributor setup works; owner can deploy the tested commit and verify it. Do not claim production deployment without actual result.
Confirm Cloudflare Free + Firebase Spark deployment choice and provider/browser checks; no billing upgrade was silently enabled.
checks: Full checks plus manual staging matrix and review; post-deploy smoke only if production is authorized.
